snippet.title: It's Chopping Time! Demo - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4272390/Its_Chopping_Time_Demo/
Or on Itchio: https://alexandre-rokh-mailliu.itch.io/its-chopping-time-demo

This is a 100% hand-drawn game by Alexandre Mailliu!

It's Chopping Time! Demo is a short incremental game about chopping down trees on a secluded island by using your mouse and the lightning strikes!

In this demo you'll only have access to the lightning strikes, which are overpowered on purpose to give you a taste of the mighty endgame unlimited power! But this is just one of the 5 forces of nature that will be featured in the final game!
